Generated on this device. No model request or upload. Supports headings, paragraphs, lists and pipe tables; other Markdown stays literal.

CSV exports only one selected table, with UTF-8 BOM. For spreadsheet safety, cells beginning with =, +, -, @ after whitespace, or a leading tab/newline, receive an apostrophe prefix. This changes cell values: formulas and negative numbers become text; the apostrophe may be visible. Review before use.
